cupertino.notes: Spec-derived, not captured: no Apple device or Apple-rendered image exists in this repository, so review is the ceiling. Checked by scripts/cupertino_spec_check.py (Light, 1x and 1.5x): sizes 44 / 34 / 28 and macOS 22 (64 least width), systemBlue and systemRed fills, tertiary fill, tint 12 to 30 %, disabled fill band, hover lighter and pressed darker, focus ring, every state differs from rest. Audit 3: not verified: 6 cells under the floor (text 4.5:1, other UI 3:1; lowest 1.6:1). Round 26: the large button is 50 pt (a large UIButton.Configuration), not 44 (the minimum tap target); scripts/cupertino_spec_check.py asserts 50.
gaps: No Apple-rendered image to measure against: every status here is derived from published iOS 17 / macOS 14 numbers, never matched to a real control
Spec check: scripts/cupertino_spec_check.py asserts the numbers above; apart from them nothing about this control is verified
Radii 12/10/8 by size and 5 for the 22 bezel are approximations
Pressed and hover shades, disabled colours and the bezel face, hairline and shadow are approximated
Picture, split and toggle buttons are not styled (fall back to Neper)
Corners are circular arcs, not the continuous (squircle) curve
No blur: shadows are stacked low-alpha shapes or one hard 1 px step; vibrancy and translucency are flat near-opaque faces
Hover is drawn only so the state is visible (touch iOS and macOS push buttons have none)
Focus ring is the runtime ring, 3 px accent at 55 % outside the control (macOS keyboard focus; iOS has none); for check, radio and switch it wraps the whole row
Audit 3: only rendering and contrast were measured; pixel fidelity to a platform reference is unverified (no live reference exists)
